description: Browse FRED economic releases (e.g. Employment Situation, CPI, GDP). With upcoming_dates=true, returns the upcoming release calendar instead. Useful for knowing when fresh data is expected.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 for observations, 25 for catalog queries).

release_id.description: Optional. If provided, return only that release's metadata.

upcoming_dates.description: If true, return upcoming release date schedule instead of release metadata. Default false.

name: fred_releases
